question: Who among the following is a professional football player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sadio Mane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sadio Mane is a professional football player**.

 
 
• Sadio Man (born 10 April 1992) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Liverpool and the Senegal national team. Mane finished fourth for the 2019 Ballon d'Or, and in the award for the Best FIFA Men's Player, he ranked fifth in 2019 and fourth in 2020.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pyotr Veniaminovich Svidler** is a Russian chess grandmaster and an eight-time Russian Chess Champion who now frequently commentates on chess.
 
• **Sven Magnus Oen Carlsen** is a Norwegian chess grandmaster who is the reigning five-time World Chess Champion. Carlsen is also a three-time World Rapid Chess Champion and five-time World Blitz Chess Champion.
 
• **Boris Gelfand** is a Soviet-born Israeli chess player.
 
 
• A six-time World Championship candidate, he won the Chess World Cup 2009 and the 2011 Candidates Tournament, making him a challenger for the World Chess Championship 2012.
